# <SOR-P-ID> — <specific proposed use>

**Overall status:** PROPOSED

**Rights-holder permission:** NOT ESTABLISHED

**User authorization:** NOT GRANTED

**Publication eligibility:** NOT CLEARED

## Material and intended action

Source ID, exact author/project, version/commit/files/ranges; copy/adapt/translate/depend/run/distribute actions; proposed recipients/visibility; affected files; alternatives. Identify a related fork/PR/contact as a separate action, not implied authorization.

## Rights-holder basis

Identify the actual rights holder and evidence. Record exact licence/permission scope, conditions, attribution/notices, modification/distribution terms, private/public limits, and unresolved compatibility. A mirror maintainer may not hold the underlying rights.

## User decision

Record whether the user accepts the licence grant as the permission basis or requires separate author permission. Record the user's explicit approval/decline and date, evidence locator, precise scope, conditions, and related decision ID. Do not invent consent or infer it from silence.

## Evidence, credit, and disclosure

Use neutral private identifiers for correspondence; retain sensitive originals locally. Record rights to publish the permission evidence itself separately from rights to use the material. Identify credit locations and preserved notices.

## Outcome and follow-up

State each gate independently; allowed version/use/files; remaining blockers; review trigger for changed use/version; and supersession links. APPROVED-FOR-STATED-SCOPE never means universal approval.
